title: ci(release): add SBOM generation, cosign artifact signing and provenance release manifests for private-installer
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add reproducible SBOM generation (syft), cosign-based artifact signing, and generate release provenance manifests for private-installer releases. CI now produces a release bundle containing signed artifacts and provenance metadata for consumption by the Private Installer release pipeline.
description:
Motivation: Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) require verifiable release artifacts for compliance and air-gapped installs. This PR adds SBOM generation, cosign signing, and release provenance manifests to the private-installer release pipeline so downstream customers and auditors can verify artifact origins.

What this change does: Adds a new release workflow that builds installer artifacts (helm chart tgz, terraform modules, installer tarballs), generates SBOMs using Syft, signs artifacts with cosign (key referenced via KMS during CI), and emits a machine-readable provenance manifest (release-manifests/provenance-<tag>.yaml) that will be uploaded to our release bucket. The workflow supports a dry-run mode for internal testing and has guards to avoid signing on forks.

Checklist: 
- [x] Build artifacts: helm chart, terraform module, installer binaries
- [x] Generate SBOM (syft) for each artifact
- [x] Sign artifacts with cosign and upload signatures
- [x] Emit provenance manifests with artifact metadata, SBOM links, and signature references
- [x] CI guards for key access and fork protection
- [x] Update release docs (docs/release/private-installer.md)

Notes: Key material is accessed in CI via the team KMS role; cosign is invoked in-subsystem and signatures are uploaded to the same release bucket as tsigs. To limit blast radius the job runs only on release tags and the release pipeline must be triggered by a maintainer. The provenance manifest follows the internal release-manifest schema used by other products (fields: name, version, artifacts[], sbom, signatures, build_info).

Related: ENG-2048 (supply-chain hardening), SUP-1290 (customer request for signed air-gapped install artifacts).

review_comments: Ethan Brooks: Overall looks good — can you add a note about key rotation and where cosign pubkeys will be published?
Maya Chen: Added a paragraph in release-manifests/README.md about key rotation and public key location in the release bucket; CI uploads pubkeys on rotation as well.
Lena Martinez: The cosign step failed in the first run due to missing KMS binding for the worker pool; suggest adding a clearer failure message and retry logic.
Maya Chen: Added clearer error messages and a retry loop (3 attempts) around cosign calls; updated workflow to surface detailed stderr logs to the Actions run.
Samir Gupta: Can we include SBOM verification as part of an integration test?
Maya Chen: Added a lightweight SBOM validation step that checks for expected packages/metadata; full verification will be part of the release acceptance checklist.
QA (internal): Verified artifacts uploaded to staging release bucket and signatures verified with cosign verify.
Security (internal): Approved after verifying KMS access controls and ensuring fork-protection in the workflow.
Release Owner: Approved for merge; will coordinate tagging and release window.
ci_summary: Actions: release-private-installer.yml — passed (build, sbom, sign, upload)
notes_on_merge: Merged after reviewers approved and CI green. Release owner to create signed tag and trigger release pipeline for production publish.
backport_instructions: If backporting to release branches, re-run the signing job with the release KMS role and ensure the provenance manifest version matches the backport tag.
upgrade_impact: Installer artifacts remain backward compatible; release manifest contains mapping from artifact -> supported installer versions.
auditor_instructions: Provenance manifests include SBOM links (syft JSON) and cosign signatures. Auditors can use cosign verify with the published public key and fetch SBOMs from the release bucket for inspection.
changelog_entry: ci(release): generate SBOMs and cosign-signed provenance manifests for private-installer releases (ENG-2048)

name: private-installer
version: v2026.02.27
artifacts:
  - path: private-installer-v2026.02.27.tgz
    sha256: <sha256>
    sbom: s3://releases/redwood/private-installer/v2026.02.27/private-installer-sbom.json
    signature: s3://releases/redwood/private-installer/v2026.02.27/private-installer.tgz.sig
audit_log: release workflow executed by maya.chen@redwood.com; artifacts uploaded to s3://releases/redwood/private-installer/v2026.02.27/; cosign signatures stored alongside artifacts.
regression_tests: Added SBOM validation and signature verification to release CI; no regressions observed in staging runs.
qa_notes: QA validated installer deploy on air-gapped staging cluster using the signed artifacts and provenance manifest; deployment succeeded and healthchecks passed.
deployer_notes: To consume signed artifacts: download the artifact and corresponding .sig, verify with cosign and the published pubkey, then proceed with the existing install flow. See release-manifests/README.md for commands.
team_impact: Security and release engineering teams will operate the new workflow; ops runbooks updated under docs/release/.
